messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT ALERT — deploy v3 canary error-rate spike on /generate (>12% 5m) · Sev=P1 · paging #incidents · trace: https://metrics/redwood/prod/canary

oncall-jen: Got it, I'm on call. Bringing up SRE + runtime. First question: can we flip the release flag or do a partial rollback?

sriram: If we flip flag release_v3 -> false we can kill new model routing quickly. Recommend flag flip first, then rollback if errors persist. :thumbsup:

alex-englead: Agreed. Flag flip is safest immediate action. If that doesn't stabilize in 2m, do manual rollback to v2. I'll own verification.

nguyen-sre: Prep steps: 1) drain canary subset (traffic weight -> 0) 2) flip feature flag 3) monitor 1min windows. Drain cmd: `curl -X POST https://ops-api/services/canary/drain -d '{"weight":0}'`

maya-pm: Noted. Are there paying customers already impacted? Tina, can you surface any active sessions / impacted tenants?

atina-cs: (tina-cs): I've got CX dashboard open. Two orgs showing errors on chat integrations (internal IDs org-17, org-42). Escalating to CSMs and prepping ACAT message if outage confirmed.

oncall-jen: Flipping flag now: `featurectl set release_v3 false --env prod --actor oncall-jen`
oncall-jen: @sriram @nguyen-sre flag flip issued — pinging after propagation. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

incident-bot: ACTION LOG — feature flag release_v3 set to false by oncall-jen at 3377770095. Propagation OK on control plane.

nguyen-sre: Traffic weight reported 85% -> 0 for canary within 18s. Starting 2-minute checks on error rate and latency.

sriram: Running quick smoke requests against /generate (10 requests across regions). All responses now 200 again, no elevated 5xx.

incident-bot: METRICS UPDATE — error-rate dropped to 1.2% (5m) 60s after flip. Latency stable.

alex-englead: Good. Hold on rollback for now. Let's keep canary drained and watch for 10 minutes. If stable, we'll start a controlled unroll of flag and follow with a tactical postmortem.

maya-pm: I'll draft customer comms for org-17 and org-42 saying brief interruption, mitigation in progress. Tina please prepare support playbook.

tina-cs: On it — CCing CSMs now.

oncall-jen: Adding checklist for post-stabilization: 1) verify logs for root cause (model mismatch / tokenization edge) 2) run canary regression test set 3) coordinate with model onboarding.

sriram: I'll capture the failing input samples and send to bench for repro. If we need rollback later, command is:

```
redwood-deploy rollback --service=generator --to-version=v2 --reason="canary error spike"
```

alex-englead: Thanks. Recording action items in the incident doc. Tentatively moving to monitoring state — paging suppressed. If we see re-increase >3% for 3 consecutive mins, re-open pager.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE — status=mitigated (canary routed -> 0, error-rate reduced). Paging suppressed. Created incident ticket INC-337777 oncall-jen.

maya-pm: Postmortem owner assignment? Alex + Sriram + Tina — please sync tomorrow 10:00 PT.

oncall-jen: Acknowledged. I'll stay on watch for 30m then handoff to next oncall. Closing thread for live actions. :white_check_mark:

tina-cs: Support notified, customers updated.

alex-englead: Nice coordination everyone. We'll capture RCA and follow up with rollout guard improvements (additional regression prompts + canary auto-drain rule).
